title: The Patient Portrait
author: Wendell Ashgrove
blurb: Isandro Pemberton, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
